//: The pull-request jobs scripts/ci/affected_jobs.py routes by the cmux-tui crate graph: a job runs when the change
touches an input of one of its crates (the crate, every crate it reaches by path dependency with the features
its build turns on, the files their sources name outside them) or one of its own inputs (a path; one ending in
/ is a directory). A workflow's `inputs` are inputs of each of its jobs. `features` are the job's --features;
a `compile_only` job runs no test, so the fixtures its crates' tests read at run time are not its inputs.
A change to this file or the router runs every job; so do pushes, dispatches and the full-ci label.
Tier A of the replay of the last merged pull requests into feat-cmux-next (cmux PR body: the table): jobs whose
reds there were never the pull request's own change (base reds, flakes, runner and queue failures), in workflows
a feat-cmux-next push runs. A pull request skips them unless it carries the full-ci label; the push that lands
it runs them, and a red there names the pull requests in its range. Each value is that job's replay record.
affected_jobs.py check: the job's if: carries PR_SKIP_IF, a push starts its workflow on every path a pull
request does, and nothing that needs it is skipped with it.
